formTitle: SER-001 Request for Sheriff to Serve Court Papers
_comment: SER-001 is the filer's form - the sheriff completes only the file number at the top - and it is in the packet because DV-100 asked "Do you want the sheriff or marshal to serve the papers ... for free?" and the answer was Yes. Most of it is what the packet already knows about the person to serve, so those fields carry the names of the questions that ask them: the names and contact details from DV-100 item 1 and 2, the description from DV-100 item 2 and DV-110 item 2, the nicknames, telephone, marks, vehicle and language from CLETS-001, the firearms answer from DV-100 item 9, and the home address from DV-110 item 2. Four boxes are true whenever SER-001 is in the packet (3a, the Yes of 3a(3), the Yes of 3a(4) and "history of violence or abuse") and carry the name of that Yes. What is left - the county, the picture, the safety checklist, how and when to find the person, and item 5 - is asked here under ser001_ names. Item 3b (serving a business) and item 6 (writs and levies) never apply to a domestic violence restraining order and are courtUse with a _why, the way DV-105(A) leaves its DV-125 box. Case number is courtUse on every page, as on every form in the packet.

fields.label: 3a. I ask the sheriff to serve a person

fields.label: 3a(3). No, I do not have any information about the person's description
fields._why: Never true in this packet: DV-100 item 2 always asks the person's age, date of birth, gender and race, so there is always a description to give and this box stays blank by design.

SER-001 is in the packet only because DV-100's "Do you want the sheriff or marshal to serve the papers ... for free?" was answered Yes, and this box is true exactly then, so the Yes box of that answer (papers_served_by_sheriff_yes) ticks it. One answer, every box it decides.

fields.label: 3a(4). Has a gun or other weapon

fields.label: 3a(4). Has a history of violence or abuse
fields._why: Always true in this packet: DV-100 is the filer's sworn account of this person's abuse (items 5 to 7), so the box is ticked whenever SER-001 is in. SER-001 is in the packet only because DV-100's "Do you want the sheriff or marshal to serve the papers ... for free?" was answered Yes, and this box is true exactly then, so the Yes box of that answer (papers_served_by_sheriff_yes) ticks it. One answer, every box it decides.
